dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped closed-loop structures are visible on the lateral mid-section. These exhibit sharp gradients from high-intensity light perimeters to dark-pixel interiors. The geometry is characterized by thin, non-uniform line widths with jagged outer perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity clusters. Small, localized pixel concentrations without internal gradients are scattered sparsely along the dorsal-most region and near the posterior transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent lateral loops form an elongated, irregular quadrilateral. Geometric relationships include a wide-angle obtuse triangle formed by the central-most ring structures.

other_distinctive_markers: Labyrinthine or reticulated network of high-contrast lines that interconnect various macro-annuli, creating a continuous, mesh-like topology across the lower lateral flank.
